checks: Protected private account routes send unauthenticated visitors to sign-in with the original route retained
Signup applies server-side validation, BCrypt-12 stores only a password hash, and an HttpOnly session cookie authenticates the user
All existing intelligence routes and new account routes render through the top application shell
Profile menu supports Escape/focus restoration and Profile/Settings/Help; theme and Hindi preference persist through refresh
Workspace shell is usable without a permanent sidebar at 1440, 1280, 1024, 768 and 390px; mobile drawer closes with Escape
Login rejects invalid credentials; eight-hour session timeout UX redirects with an explicit expiry message
Server-side expiry rejects a still-signed JWT when its tracked session has expired
Logout revokes backend session, clears cookie, and protected routes require sign-in; auth modal keeps header visible without nested scrolling
